svg.title: vgacap overview
svg.desc: A Tiny Tapeout demo board's uo_out is captured by the board's own RP2040 or RP2350 (PIO and DMA), a Raspberry Pi 5 (RP1 PIO and DMA), capture logic in an FPGA, or a simulator; all write one vgacap stream, which libvgaframe turns into pictures, video and pixel-exact checks.
svg.text: an ASIC or an FPGA breakout on top;
the design drives VGA on uo_out
